data_fields.name: zone_object_range
data_fields.donor_constant: (not read: getZoneObjectRange not in donor box)

best_idea: Keep an explicit per-player interest set that changes only on crossings (enter when in range now, leave when it was in range before and is out now), fed by a radius query that culls whole quadrants before testing entities, so the server sends only pairs that changed.
decision_why: Keep the crossing-based enter and leave and the node-culled radius query; add a per-tick cap on enter and leave work and per-zone radius data; reject the donor's tree mutex and its character-batch clear.
acceptance: A server test runs 2,000 random moves of 20 entities in a 512-unit zone and asserts that after every move each entity's interest set equals the brute-force set of entities within range, and that every pair fires one enter and one leave per crossing.
